      "observations": [
        "All eligible owned hunks in all 15 paths were inspected. Fourteen complete paths are exported as a selected diff; safe old shared-preference ranges are exact snapshots. The full mailnews.js diff is excluded because its unchanged context contains Suite-only conditional content.",
        "The migration adds 23 existing preference names to StaticPrefList.yaml with mirror:always and removes traditional defaults. Thunderbird already overrode operate_on_msgs_in_collapsed_threads to true; the new static declaration retains true. The other inspected effective defaults remain the stated Boolean or integer values. No new stored key is introduced.",
        "Always-mirrored declarations do not update fields that consumers copy. nsMimeBaseEmitter stores mail_show_headers in its constructor and later filters with mHeaderDisplayType. HTML WriteHTMLHeaders obtains the accessor for each BroadcastHeaders call; date formatting likewise reads its timezone accessor per call.",
        "mime_bridge_create_display_stream copies wrapping, charset, attachment and HTML-mode preferences into stream state. It still negates mail_fixed_width_messages before assigning variable-width behavior. Plain and flowed parse_begin functions copy quote and font settings at parse setup; citation_color remains a string preference read through Preferences.",
        "The class-selection and alternative-part paths retain their output-mode exclusions: filtering/decryption/attachment modes bypass the relevant HTML-mode preference reads, plain-flowed support has its own filter/attachment/raw guards, and prefer_plaintext is suppressed for SaveAs and Raw. The patch does not establish a global MIME-policy bypass or sanitizer guarantee.",
        "Forwarded-message header selection now uses MicroHeaders, NormalHeaders and AllHeaders names instead of 0, 1 and 2. The default switch branch still chooses normal headers. The database-view preference accessor remains behind its stand-alone-window guard and feeds selection, selected counts and non-dummy selection checks.",
        "No tests change. The selected existing message/rfc822 fixture sets inline_attachments both ways and its stream-completion callback directly compares attachment counts. It does not measure static-accessor performance, preference changes during an existing stream or live header-cache refresh. Its existing assertion message is absent; this patch does not edit that assertion.",
        "Includes and namespace use are changed in the C++ translation units, including removal of the unused PGP proxy Preferences include. Exact generated accessor spelling and enum names are local accepted C++ usage. Existing comment wording, single-line guards and include duplicates do not create broader style rules.",

It provides no measured speedup, preference-change timing test or fresh MIME rendering result. Source establishes the exact 23 names, existing caller guards and copied-state boundaries.",
